faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Trichy Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Research Associate position at NIT Trichy is 27 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the required qualification for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Research Associate position, candidates must have submitted their PhD thesis or possess a doctorate degree in Organic Synthesis from a recognized and reputable institution.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 58,000 per month, along with 16% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Research Associate job at NIT Trichy?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it via Speed Post or Registered Post to the address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Research Associate recruitment at NIT Trichy.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate position at NIT Trichy will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Associate position announced by the National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and the application form can be downloaded from the official website of NIT Trichy, which is https://www.nitt.edu. Links are also provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Research Associate position at NIT Trichy is on a contract basis.
